description: Independent native reference Save As output for synthetic SmartArt text-body controls. Source XML is from unsaved authored controls; expected properties and children are read from native diagram drawings after verifying the authored layout survived. Covers ordinary/custom text, first contributor selection, missing first text, preserved authored formatting, algorithm-owned wrapping/columns/autofit, fractional and negative constraint margins, warps and 3D. The custom-text reader supplies the diagram primary-font fallback when a customized contributor has no text; font selection is outside body-property projection. The native omitted compatLnSpc defaults to false and must be explicit when projected into a PML shape.
